description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It creates a TV-optimized home screen with multiple horizontally scrolling rows, each displaying a list of CardItems with images and progress bars. It includes custom presenters for rendering image cards with focus scaling, highlighting, and progress indicators. The file encapsulates UI setup, data models, and presentation logic for the TV home UI.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that builds a TV-optimized home screen with horizontal rows, showing 'Seguí viendo' and 'Canales de TV' sections with image cards and progress indicators.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model representing an individual card with title, image resource, and progress value.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: Selects and provides the custom card presenter for rendering CardItems.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for image cards with focus effects, custom colors, and progress bars.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI after the activity is created, calling buildUI().

methods.name: buildUI
methods.description: Sets up the header styles, creates rows and adapters, and defines click and selection listeners.

methods.name: buildListRow
methods.description: Constructs a ListRow with a header and list of CardItems.

methods.name: buildContinueWatchingItems
methods.description: Creates a list of CardItems representing 'Continue Watching' movies with images and progress.

methods.name: buildTvChannelItems
methods.description: Creates a list of CardItems for TV channels.

methods.name: setThemeColor
methods.description: Initializes or sets theme color for the card presenter (placeholder in this context).

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a custom ImageCardView with focus effects, scaled animations, and colors.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from CardItem to the ImageCardView, updates image, title, and adds a progress bar.

methods.name: buildProgressBar
methods.description: Builds a horizontal progress bar view representing the card's progress.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears images to free memory when unbinding view holder.
